title: A seat revoked while its page is open gets a localized notice, a way to My Sites and an inert composer that keeps its layout
steps: S1: As B (editor of the test site) open $O/<site>/ in a 360x800 mobile context and wait for [data-composer-input="true"]; click it and type a two-line sentence (about 100 characters). Read the composer card [data-slot="conversation.composer.bar"] [data-composer-card]: its data-tc-draft attribute and the width of [data-composer-input].
S2: As A (owner) revoke B: GET /api/team, take B's seat id, then DELETE /api/sites/<site>/seats/<id> with body {"kind":"revoke"} (Origin = $O).
S3: In B's page press Enter in the composer, wait 8 s, then read [data-viewer-bar="removed"]: visible, its <a> href, the composer card's inert property, and the draft text.
S4: Repeat S1-S3 at 1440x900 after inviting B again (POST /api/team/invite role editor, then POST /api/sites/<site>/accept as B).
expect: S1: data-tc-draft = own-row; the draft is at least 200 px wide (never a sliver beside the + and role chip).
S3: the bar is visible with the seat.removed text in the page language, its link href = /new/?tab=tracy:my-sites, the card is inert (true), the draft text is unchanged.
S4: same as S3; the draft row spans the card above + / role chip / send.
evidence: e2e 04/10 J7.8 (tasks/evidence/e2e-full-dev/2026-10-04/R-wp/bugs/J7.8-D-ui.md): a revoked seat's message went nowhere with no word on screen, the draft squeezed into a narrow column; after the fix tasks/evidence/tracy-site-sweep/L3/J7.8/
fence: createSeatRole marks the seat removed when a read that had the site's row finds it gone (every send re-reads); SeatBar draws RemovedBar and makes the composer inert; draftLayout gives the draft its own row below the 160 px floor

tests: a row that vanishes after the page had it marks the seat removed
a first read without the row is not a removal
a seat invited again after removal is no longer removed
the draft takes its own row when the controls beside it leave less than the draft floor
